name: Ecommerce Sales vs Finance Recognized Revenue
description: Compare monthly gross order revenue from the ecommerce database against recognized accounting revenue from the finance database.

sources.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS ecommerce_gmv, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'completed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
SELECT fiscal_month AS month, recognized_revenue AS finance_revenue, audit_status FROM ledger_monthly_revenue ORDER BY month;

name: Marketing Ad Spend vs Product Gross Revenue
description: Correlate marketing campaign expenditure from an external marketing analytics DB with ecommerce product sales.

sources.sql: SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, ROUND(SUM(spend), 2) AS total_ad_spend FROM external_campaigns GROUP BY campaign_id, campaign_name;

SELECT c.campaign_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS attributed_sales FROM campaigns c JOIN ad_impressions ai ON c.campaign_id = ai.campaign_id JOIN order_items oi ON ai.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.campaign_id;

name: Marketplace Payouts vs Banking Settlement
description: Reconcile internal seller payout records against external banking disbursement batches.

sources.sql: SELECT seller_id, payout_date, net_payout, payout_status FROM seller_payouts WHERE payout_status = 'completed';
SELECT seller_id, settlement_date AS payout_date, settled_amount, wire_reference FROM wire_transfers WHERE transfer_status = 'cleared';
